notes.title: The second minor update was made.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm Ryuhei Nishino (西野竜平) from "Ryuheidou (竜平堂)" an independent game developer.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/2fbad0331446c74054a73f57891c22406969a5b0.jpg"]

We’ve released a minor update for our spicy action game "KOKORONULL," which launched on August 15, 2024!

Update Details:

Adjustment of keyboard and controller input

Tweaks to UI and effects

Other minor improvements

We kindly ask all players who have purchased the game to please uninstall and reinstall the game to apply the latest update. We apologize for the inconvenience.



--------------------



With this minor update, the core game system is now complete.

Next, we will be working on a major update, which will include:

New character appearances and added animations

Addition of a narrative to the game

Story developments similar to a visual novel



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/a65354c222c07158d7f3aaa39f381a31bc61dab9.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/3d674c4dd2acc7f084d002b2bd596b2c93393640.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/1f09021372833aebd05f8cff898e5f9b4f381f13.png"]

We hope you'll continue to follow and support us!

Thank you again for your continued support of Ryuheidou!

Let me know if you'd like a shorter or more formal version as well!

notes.title: The first minor update was made.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone (´ω`)ノ

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/2fbad0331446c74054a73f57891c22406969a5b0.jpg

On August 15th, we released the spicy action game “KOKORONULL”.
We’ve now made a minor update to the game.

The details of the update are as follows:

 Added and updated input instructions for both keyboard and controller.
 You can now exit the game with the Select and Start buttons on the controller or the ESC key on the keyboard.
 Localization stability improvements.
 Various small adjustments.


We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but we kindly ask all players to uninstall the game and reinstall it to apply the changes.

----------

With this minor update, the core game system is now complete.
Next, we plan to release a major update, which will include:

 New characters and performances.
 Addition of the game’s narrative.
 Story progression similar to a visual novel.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/a65354c222c07158d7f3aaa39f381a31bc61dab9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/3d674c4dd2acc7f084d002b2bd596b2c93393640.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/1f09021372833aebd05f8cff898e5f9b4f381f13.png

We appreciate your continued support and look forward to bringing you more exciting content. Thank you for playing!
